description: Department of Labour - The Cost of Living Index Number for the Month of May 2015 applicable to workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade was 179.8 and the Special Allowance for a normal working day in the Month of June 2015 will be Rs. 555.71
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the declaration of the Cost of Living Index Number and the calculation of a special allowance for workers, which is done under the authority of the Wages Boards Ordinance. This constitutes a regulatory matter and the publication of a legally mandated calculation, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (new regulations, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements). While a government official is named, the core content is regulatory, not about the person's appointment or their portfolio responsibilities.
